name: collect_wood_from_trees
description: Cut all nearby trees to obtain at least 30 Wood.
task: Hold at least 30 Wood (any kind: Wood, BorealWood, PalmWood...).

name: make_workbench
description: Crafts one WorkBench from the available Wood.
task: Hold a work bench (any wood variant counts, e.g. BorealWoodWorkBench).

name: obtain_wooden_hammer
description: Collects wood, builds a workbench, then crafts one WoodenHammer.
task: Hold a wooden hammer (any wood variant counts).

name: mine_30_stoneblocks
description: Mine 30 StoneBlock tiles using the existing pickaxe.

name: obtain_wooden_chair_and_table
description: Collects wood, builds a workbench, crafts a wooden hammer, then creates a wooden chair and table.
task: Hold a wooden chair and a wooden table (any wood variant counts).

name: get_wooden_door
description: Collect wood, create a workbench, then craft one WoodenDoor.
task: Hold a wooden door (any wood variant counts).

name: make_furnace
description: Build a WorkBench and craft one Furnace

name: hold_workbench_with_wood
description: Cuts nearby trees to get 30 Wood and crafts a WorkBench.
task: Hold a work bench (any wood variant counts, e.g. BorealWoodWorkBench).
